clips.headline: Why Immediate Good Deeds Are Better Than Delayed Ones
clips.lesson_summary: Explains that gathering reward now is better than waiting for a larger future reward, with practical examples.

clips.headline: The Weight of This World vs. the Hereafter
clips.lesson_summary: Shows that the entirety of this dunya does not equal even a speck of the Hereafter, using Qur’an and hadith evidence.

clips.headline: Beware of Evil Companions and Temporary Desires
clips.hook_sentence: Do not be deceived by evil companions that you have.
clips.lesson_summary: The speaker warns that evil friends and fleeting desires can mislead you and cause doubt in Allah’s promises, urging vigilance.
